description: Immutable audit trail for agent actions. CloudTrail multi-region trail with S3 WORM (Object Lock), KMS encryption, and optional CloudWatch Logs streaming. The agent cannot delete or modify its own audit log.
capabilities: Creates CloudTrail multi-region trail capturing all management and S3 data events
Creates S3 bucket with Object Lock GOVERNANCE mode — logs immutable for retention_days
Creates dedicated KMS key for CloudTrail encryption — agent role excluded from key policy
Enforces DenyDeleteObject bucket policy — no principal can delete logs
Enables CloudTrail log file validation — detects tampering via digital signatures
Optionally streams events to CloudWatch Log Group for real-time alerting
Denies non-TLS access to the S3 bucket
llm_hints: This module has NO VPC dependency — CloudTrail is a global service, no vpc_id needed
S3 bucket name includes account_id automatically — no need to make it unique in variables
force_destroy=false is intentional — terraform destroy will fail if logs exist in the bucket
To read logs, grant kms:Decrypt on the kms_key_arn output to the reader role
For stricter compliance than GOVERNANCE mode, change Object Lock to COMPLIANCE mode — cannot be bypassed by anyone
cloudwatch_log_group_name output can be used to create CloudWatch Metric Filters for alerting on specific agent actions
security_notes: Object Lock GOVERNANCE mode prevents deletion during retention period
DenyDeleteObject bucket policy is an explicit deny — overrides any allow on any role
KMS key policy grants GenerateDataKey to CloudTrail service only — agent cannot decrypt logs
enable_log_file_validation detects if log files are modified or deleted after delivery
Multi-region trail captures API calls in all regions — agent cannot evade by switching regions
